messages:
PagerBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired for inference-router-eu-prod (high error rate). Reason: 502 spike across edge proxies. PD incident: INC-78421. Escalation policy: infra-second-level.

maya: acked. I'm on call — taking initial triage. Checking dashboards.

sam: thanks @maya. if you need platform assist, tag me. I can look at autoscaler and LB rules.

maya: quick snapshot — 502 rate ~12% over last 5m, latency up ~300ms. CPU/GPU utilization looks normal. Logs show repeated `upstream reset` from proxy.

liam: @maya can you paste the tail of the proxy logs? might be an origin pool flapping.

maya: grabbing logs now. here's recent snippet:
```
2026-03-15T19:45:03Z proxy[pid=1245] ERROR upstream reset by peer: 7/200 requests
2026-03-15T19:45:04Z proxy[pid=1245] WARN connection closed early
2026-03-15T19:45:05Z router[pid=210] INFO routed to backend inference-pool-b (200 ok)
```

sam: hmm looks like one of the backend pools intermittently rejecting. Could be node OOM or network blips.

maya: rolling bckend pool counts — `k get pods -n redwood inference-pool-a -o wide` shows 3/3 ready, pool-b 2/3 ready.

maya: running quick restart on pool-b pod-22 and pod-23 to see if it stabilizes.

support-bot: Command executed by maya: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-pool-b -n redwood`

maya: restarted. monitoring.

PagerBot: :thumbsup: Pager acknowledged by maya (oncall). Escalation level: waiting on platform response.

liam: @maya any customer-facing impact so far? need to decide whether to run failover.

maya: traffic dropped to pool-b by 40% due to 502s; customers seeing intermittent failures in EU region only. Notified support to flag high severity for impacted orgs. No global outage.

sam: I can kick a controlled failover for a subset of traffic to inference-router-us-prod. Suggest weighted shift of 30% then 100% if stable.

maya: agree. start with 30% for 5 minutes. If 502s drop below 0.5%, ramp to 100%.

sam: initiating controlled reroute. command:
```
# shift 30% to us
curl -X POST https://ops-api/redwood/routing -d '{"service":"inference-router","from":"eu","to":"us","weight":30}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***'
```

sam: done. watch the error rate.

maya: error rate in EU dropped from 12% -> 3% within 2m. Good sign.

liam: can we also add a temporary 429 -> 200 shim for clients to reduce retries? might reduce load.

sam: implementing 429 retry cap at LB level now.

PagerBot: :information_source: PD note updated: assigned to maya, with platform support sam. Incident status: mitigation in progress. INC-78421.

maya: current plan: keep 30% shift for 5m, if stable move to 100% and scale pool-b to 4 replicas. After stabilization, collect postmortem and rollback route.

support-bot: Support ticket RT-9921 created and linked to PD incident. Notifying affected customers via template.

maya: moving to 100% now; observing.

sam: route at 100%. EU 502s at 0.1% now. Pool-b shows all pods Ready.

maya: marking as mitigated — moving to post-incident review. Leaving PD page open until postmortem assigned.

liam: thanks team. Assigning follow-up action items: 1) root cause triage (logs + backend health checks) 2) autoscaler config audit 3) improve LB retry/backoff rules. I'll own RCA.

maya: assigning postmortem owner liam. I'll file timeline + notes.

PagerBot: :white_check_mark: PD incident INC-78421 status changed to mitigated by maya. Please follow up in postmortem thread.

maya: closing thread here, will open PM for RCA. :wave:
